rules.title: Answer to Complaint
rules.description: Answer must be filed within 20 days after service of complaint (Pa. R.C.P. 1028)
rules.text: A defendant must file an answer within 20 days after service of the complaint.

rules.title: Motion to Dismiss
rules.description: Motion to dismiss for failure to state a cause of action (Pa. R.C.P. 1017)
rules.text: A party may move to dismiss if the complaint fails to state a cause of action.

rules.title: Discovery - Interrogatories
rules.description: Response to interrogatories must be served within 30 days (Pa. R.C.P. 4003.1)
rules.text: Responses to interrogatories must be served within 30 days after being served.

rules.title: Notice of Deposition
rules.description: Notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before deposition date (Pa. R.C.P. 4003.5)
rules.text: A notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before the deposition date.

localRules.court: Philadelphia County Court of Common Pleas
localRules.title: Motion Practice
localRules.text: All motions must include a concise statement of the claim or defense.

deadlines.description: Answer filing deadline (20 days from service)
